literal_gate_scope.note: Eq.(3) places f_{i,j,k} after the aggregate while describing edge-wise attention adjustment; scope is therefore preregistered as an explicit ambiguity variable.

literal_gate_activation.note: The paper calls f_{i,j,k} a neural network but does not specify its output nonlinearity; sigmoid is retained as the frozen default and softplus tests positive amplification without allowing sign flips.

communication_comparison.note: Event/periodic/always comparisons replay the same event-trained checkpoint; communication mode is not retrained for the causal quality-cost comparison.

communication_accounting.full_sync: all node and edge feature arrays
communication_accounting.event_sync: refreshed node arrays plus serialized event records

evaluation_audit.trace: per-decision projected and realized makespan, action, reward, event, synchronization
evaluation_audit.flops: analytical multiply-add estimate for the active linear forward path
evaluation_audit.gate_statistics: gate distribution and actual PPO probe gradient
